purpose: Teach: 容積/相乗/喝采/セレクション/省エネルギー/真っ最中/ダントツ/授賞

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、押収品の容積管理もされますね
lines.en: The police manage seized evidence volumes carefully, don't they.
lines.style: Respectful, observational. Gentle upward inflection on the question tag. Speaking as if noting something he's learned. Warm but formal register.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地域パトロールの相乗効果も意識されますね
lines.en: The police are very mindful of the synergistic effect of community patrols, aren't they.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. Slight emphasis on 'synergistic'—he's articulating something he finds genuinely impressive. Steady pace, no rush.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民の喝采を浴びる活動もされますね
lines.en: The police do receive public acclaim for their work, don't they.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment. Light, almost pleased tone—genuinely noting good work. Soft rise on the tag question, as if inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、特捜隊員のセレクションを厳格にされますね
lines.en: The police are quite rigorous in selecting special task force members, aren't they.
lines.style: Serious, impressed. Slight weight on 'rigorous'—respect for the standard. Clear, unhurried delivery. Nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署の省エネルギー化も進められますね
lines.en: The police are making progress on energy efficiency at the stations too, aren't they.
lines.style: Observant, appreciative of the detail. Casual but attentive—noting something practical and forward-thinking. Soft tag, like connecting dots aloud.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査の真っ最中ですからご協力をされますね
lines.en: Since the investigation is in active progress, you're all cooperating, aren't you.
lines.style: Gentle shift—slightly more serious. Acknowledging the moment and the weight of it. Respectful, not rushed. Understands why cooperation matters now.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、ダントツの検挙率を維持されますね
lines.en: The police do maintain an exceptional arrest rate, don't they.
lines.style: Clear respect in the voice. Emphasis on 'exceptional'—stating a fact he admires. Even pace, poised. The tone of someone who knows this means something.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、勇敢な警官への授賞式もされますね
lines.en: And you do hold awards ceremonies for your brave officers, don't you.
lines.style: Warm, personal shift—addressing the listener directly now. Less question, more gentle affirmation. Soft but clear. A note of genuine regard underneath.
